Okay, this is... a trainwreck XD lol. When I stumbled upon the raws of this, I really loved the core idea with the sapient "Room you can't leave until have sex" though, so I decided to pick it up. I didn't even notice that time that the book "Mr. Room" gave them said "From the age of 5" (in fact, the book's cover is censored, but then the boy read the title out loud... XD lol - side note, the characters on the book cover look just like them, so I gues the room has the ability to create whatever random bullshit to help the couple currently in there.
5 years old is a bit... XD though, it's implied there was some time skip, it's unclear how much, though ultimately since it's just fiction either way, it doesn't matters. At first I thought it was the "standard-ish" 12 or so for loli/shota, but then... I did work on some stuff from this author before too, and they went below that number there too. now they went even below that... XD

That aside, I think there's so much potential in the core idea that there's a sapient room that must enforce the rule no matter what, but the couple can't have sex yet for some reason, causing them to spend an unusually long time (perhaps years?) in there.

Also, the ending was quite "wholesome" in a strange way XD

(also, also, I have 3 doujins ready for uploading now, so this is not the only new upload this time!)

Anyway, enough blabbering, right?
I hope you enjoy reading it~!
